summary: Your twelfth Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on permissions, tool calling, tool errors and the gateway with a confidence number, extend your glossary, start two services from cold using only your README, group your confusions into 3 themes, tag week 12 and plan week 13.
goal: Explain permissions, tool calling and the gateway in your own words, start two services from cold, and plan week 13.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Run it from cold: database, Python service, gateway and one curl through .NET using only your README
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Run git tag week-12 and see tag: week-12 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 13: one outcome sentence, 7 sessions in your calendar, a drop list
Play the Week 12 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
